finePrint.summary: Vendor can change the agreement at any time without notice, so lifetime-deal terms could be altered later.

quote.text: (unlimphotos.com) reserves the right to change this Agreement at any time without further notice.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can change its pricing structure whenever needed, which threatens price-lock expectations for a lifetime deal.

quote.text: We reserve the right to update and/or change our pricing structure as needed.

finePrint.summary: Even legacy subscription plans can have their pricing changed at any time.

quote.text: All subscriptions are subject to pricing changes at any time, including legacy plans.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can cut off site access and remove content without prior notice for breach or illegal use.

quote.text: (unlimphotos.com) may restrict or remove your access to this site at any time and restrict or remove any content without prior notification if there is a breach of contract or illegal use.

trials.claim: Lifetime access to Unlimphotos Plan for $79 (was $690)
trials.claimQuote:
### Unlimphotos: $79 (was $690)
- Lifetime access to Unlimphotos Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say legacy plans can face pricing changes at any time and the vendor may restrict or remove site access at any time, materially limiting the lifetime-access promise.

exhibits.quote: All subscriptions are subject to pricing changes at any time, including legacy plans.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime price is undermined because even legacy plans can have pricing changed at any time.

exhibits.quote: (unlimphotos.com) may restrict or remove your access to this site at any time
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the vendor can restrict or remove access at any time.

exhibits.quote: what you paid for a LIFETIME subscription is what most of the bigger sites charges for one or two MONTHS.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the purchase was sold as a lifetime subscription.

trials.claimQuote:
35 image downloads per day limit
- Copyright protection
- Advanced AI search & filters
- Lifetime access, including new content
trials.reasoning: Two buyers independently confirm receiving 35 downloads/photos per day as promised, and the prosecution exhibits do not show that limit is not provided.

exhibits.quote: Failing to comply with the fair use may limit or even cancelation your account.
exhibits.argument: The 35-per-day limit is undermined because fair-use enforcement can further limit or cancel the account.

exhibits.quote: There's only been a small number of photos that I could download out of the three sizes for many of the photos regarding the small size.
exhibits.argument: The download promise is undermined because the buyer reports most photos cannot be downloaded in all sizes.

exhibits.quote: The seal allows 35 free photos a day, which is perfectly good for most of us.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the 35-per-day download allowance works as promised.

exhibits.quote: I am a new blogger and the 35 downloads a day is more than enough.
exhibits.argument: Second buyer confirms the 35 downloads per day limit applies to the purchase.

trials.claim: All future Unlimphotos Plan updates included
trials.claimQuote:
All future Unlimphotos Plan updates
- Please note: This deal is not stackable
- Access to over 12M images & vectors
trials.reasoning: The terms reserve the right to change the agreement without notice and subject legacy plans to pricing changes, materially limiting the promise that all future plan updates are included.

exhibits.quote: (unlimphotos.com) reserves the right to change this Agreement at any time without further notice.
exhibits.argument: Future updates are undermined because the vendor can change the agreement at any time without notice.

exhibits.quote: All subscriptions are subject to pricing changes at any time, including legacy plans.
exhibits.argument: Future updates are undermined because legacy plans are explicitly subject to pricing changes.

trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access, including new content
## Refund
60-day money-back guarantee
trials.reasoning: The binding terms refuse refunds for downloaded images/vectors and limit full refunds to low usage, conflicting with an unconditional 60-day money-back guarantee.

exhibits.quote: We do not offer refunds for downloaded vectors or images.
exhibits.argument: The money-back guarantee is undermined because refunds are refused once images or vectors are downloaded.

exhibits.quote: We do offer refunds for the whole product, if you find it to not meet your expectations, and the usage rate is low.
exhibits.argument: The guarantee is undermined because a full refund is limited to low usage rate.

trials.claim: Growing collection of 12M+ authentic stock photos
trials.claimQuote: A growing collection of 12M+ authentic stock photos
trials.reasoning: The vendor states 100,000 photos are added and a buyer confirms millions of images to choose from, supporting a growing large collection; complaints about quality and search do not contradict its size or growth.

exhibits.quote: It's very limited with the quality of majority of photos and they' re on the very low end.
exhibits.argument: The growing 12M+ authentic collection claim is undermined by a buyer reporting very limited low-end quality.

exhibits.quote: Unlimphotos search capabilities are too limited to easily find relevant photos.
exhibits.argument: The collection claim is undermined by a buyer reporting search is too limited to find relevant photos.

exhibits.quote: Get the images you want and the legal protection with 100,000 photos added
exhibits.argument: Vendor states new photos are added continuously, supporting a growing collection.

exhibits.quote: There are millions of images to choose from, and I always find something I can use every time I go to the site and do a search for a use case.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms millions of images are available to choose from.

trials.claim: Access to over 12M images and vectors
trials.claimQuote:
Access to over 12M images & vectors
- Standard & extended licenses
- 35 image downloads per day limit
trials.reasoning: Exhibits only describe 'millions' or a 'big' collection and compare it vaguely to a competitor, with none verifying access to over 12M images and vectors specifically.

exhibits.quote: Not nearly as many images as 123RF, but reasonable for the price.
exhibits.argument: The over-12M images claim is undermined by a buyer reporting far fewer images than a competitor.

exhibits.quote: I am used to having the option, though, of selecting which type of file I'm looking for (.eps, psd, png, etc.) which this site has not yet implemented.
exhibits.argument: Access to images and vectors is undermined because file-type selection for vectors and other formats is not implemented.

exhibits.quote: There are millions of images to choose from, and I always find something I can use every time I go to the site and do a search for a use case.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms access to millions of images for use.

exhibits.quote: It is nice that they have a pretty big collection of photos that you can use unlimited.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms access to a large collection usable on an unlimited basis.
